# Host nginx in front of the Platform, with the connectors' client-certificate terminator

> Terminates HTTPS for the Platform on the host and, given the client CA that signs the sites' certificates, passes the SHA-256 of a verified client certificate to the Platform as X-Client-Cert-Fingerprint.

## Identity

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | L2-HOST-NGINX |
| Kind | infrastructure |
| Owner | ROLE-ENGINE-OWNER |
| Level | 2 |

### Source paths

- KnovasPlatform/deploy/host-nginx
- scripts/host-https.sh

## Purpose

### Responsible for

| Id | Statement | Code |
|---|---|---|
| L2-HOST-NGINX/R-1 | The host's nginx site for the Platform, TLS on port 443 and a redirect plus the ACME challenge on port 80. | KnovasPlatform/deploy/host-nginx/knovas-platform.conf.example; scripts/host-https.sh |
| L2-HOST-NGINX/R-2 | The connector protocol's client-certificate terminator (knovas-client-cert.js, knovas-connector-mtls.conf). | KnovasPlatform/deploy/host-nginx/knovas-client-cert.js; KnovasPlatform/deploy/host-nginx/knovas-connector-mtls.conf |
| L2-HOST-NGINX/R-3 | The login throttle's zone and the access-log format without a request line (knovas-login-limit.conf). | KnovasPlatform/deploy/host-nginx/knovas-login-limit.conf |

### Not responsible for

- Deciding whether a component may call; the Platform checks the control token and the recorded fingerprint.
- The nginx inside the Platform's compose stack (docbridge-web-nginx).

### Terms

- client CA (the CA that signs the sites' certificates)
- terminator (the TLS end that verifies a client certificate and passes on its fingerprint)

## Offers

### Operations

| Id | Name | Entrance | Ref |
|---|---|---|---|
| install | sudo scripts/host-https.sh FQDN EMAIL [CLIENT_CA_PEM] | cli | scripts/host-https.sh |
| https-proxy | Port 443, every path, proxied to the Platform on 127.0.0.1 (DOCBRIDGE_WEB_PORT, default 8081) | http | knovas-platform.conf.example, server 443, location / |
| login-throttle | Port 443, location = /login, throttled per client address, then proxied | http | knovas-platform.conf.example, server 443, location = /login |
| http-redirect | Port 80, the ACME challenge from /var/www/letsencrypt and a 301 to HTTPS for everything else | http | knovas-platform.conf.example, server 80 |

#### Promises

| Id | Statement | Risk class | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| L2-HOST-NGINX/install/P-1 | Writes the site from the template with the name, the Let's Encrypt certificate and the port from knovas.env, requests a certificate only when none is there, enables the site, reloads nginx and installs a renewal hook that reloads it again. | standard |  |
| L2-HOST-NGINX/install/P-2 | Given the client CA, installs it at /etc/nginx/knovas/connector-client-ca.pem with the njs file and its conf and switches the terminator lines on; once installed, later runs keep the terminator. | critical | kind: test, ref: KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_connector_terminator_config.py, checks: test_host_https_installs_the_terminator_only_with_a_client_ca; test_with_the_client_ca_the_header_is_the_verified_certificates_hash |

### `https-proxy`

#### Promises

| Id | Statement | Risk class | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| L2-HOST-NGINX/https-proxy/P-1 | X-Client-Cert-Fingerprint is always set by nginx, never passed on from a client - empty without the terminator; with it, the SHA-256 (hex) of the DER of the client certificate nginx verified against the client CA, and empty when no certificate was verified. | critical | kind: test, ref: KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_connector_terminator_config.py, checks: test_the_template_strips_the_header_and_leaves_the_terminator_off; test_with_the_client_ca_the_header_is_the_verified_certificates_hash; test_the_hash_is_empty_unless_nginx_verified_the_certificate; kind: measurement, ref: run by hand in nginx with njs on 2026-11-07 (test_connector_terminator_config.py's docstring), checks: a verified certificate gave sha256(DER); no certificate and a forged header gave an empty header; a certificate of another CA was refused (400) |
| L2-HOST-NGINX/https-proxy/P-2 | A client certificate is optional (ssl_verify_client optional), so Knovas Link enrols and beats before its certificate is recorded and browsers are not asked for one. | standard | kind: test, ref: KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_connector_terminator_config.py, checks: test_with_the_client_ca_the_header_is_the_verified_certificates_hash |
| L2-HOST-NGINX/https-proxy/P-3 | X-Forwarded-For is set to the address nginx saw, never appended to, so a client cannot name its own address. | critical | kind: test, ref: KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_experiments_leftovers_deploydocs.py, checks: test_compose_trusts_exactly_the_proxies_that_add_an_entry |

#### Limits

| Id | Statement | Risk class | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|

| L2-HOST-NGINX/https-proxy/L-2 | A request body is at most 32 MB (client_max_body_size 32m); TLS 1.2 and 1.3 only; HSTS for a year. | standard |  |

### `login-throttle`

#### Limits

| Id | Statement | Risk class |
|---|---|---|
| L2-HOST-NGINX/login-throttle/L-1 | At most 10 requests a minute per client address with a burst of 5; beyond that nginx answers 429 before the Platform sees the request. | standard |
